parts_rule: Hard characters are built in parts: BODY (bound to the 106 rig, strict bind gate) plus GEAR parts (coat, cloak, mantle; hang from the body skeleton and cape/skirt helper bones, looser gate). One asset id, sub-parts.
ref_prefix: Edit instruction: keep this exact same character from the reference image: identical face, hair, moustache, skin and body build. Change only the following:
style: Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, soft even studio lighting, plain neutral grey background, centred, full figure head to feet fully visible, sharp, 4k character reference. Not cartoon, not stylised, no text.

rows.name: body_underlayer
rows.prompt: Remove the cloak, fur mantle, coat, tabard, belt, medallions and boots. He stands in a neutral A-pose facing the camera, arms slightly away from the body, wearing only a plain form-fitting dark grey long-sleeve base layer, trousers and plain dark shoes, with the same pale gaunt face, long black hair and thin moustache. Hands bare, fingers relaxed and slightly apart.

rows.name: coat_alone
rows.prompt: Show ONLY the crimson damask long coat with dense gold embroidery, high stiff collar, embroidered tabard with castle and cross, ornate belt with double-headed eagle buckle and white ruffled cuffs, worn on a plain faceless dress mannequin in an A-pose, front view. No head, no person, no cloak, no fur mantle, no boots.

rows.name: cloak_alone
rows.prompt: Show ONLY the long dark cloak with the heavy black fur mantle over the shoulders and the gold medallions set with red gems joined by chains, hanging on a plain faceless mannequin, front view. No head, no person, no coat, no boots.

rows.name: boots_alone
rows.prompt: Show ONLY a pair of tall black leather boots with gilded knee plates standing side by side on the floor, front view, with nothing else in the picture.
